annotations.title: Check if a UK subcontractor needs a right to work check

description: UK only. Says whether a business must do a right to work check on a subcontractor, gig worker or platform worker under the rule in force from 1 October 2026 (Border Security, Asylum and Immigration Act 2025, s48), and what to do. Free. General information, not legal advice.

contract_holder.description: Who has the contract with the worker: the asking business directly, or one of its subcontractors.

role.description: Who is asking: a business taking on self-employed people for its jobs, an app or platform matching workers to customers, an employment agency, or a homeowner hiring a tradesperson.

start_date.description: Date the contract or arrangement with the worker was agreed (entered into), YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

work_arrangement.description: How the worker works: as an individual (sole trader or worker's contract), through their own limited company, or as an independent business with many customers of its own.

name: check_subcontractor_right_to_work_duty
title: Check if a UK subcontractor needs a right to work check
